stories.title: Presidents Cup Day 1 Eve — Opening Ceremony Tomorrow at Medinah

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text: The Presidents Cup opens TOMORROW at Medinah. Five fourball matches start at 11:35 AM CDT. USA leads the all-time series 13-2. The International team hasn't won since 1998. 28 years. Starts tomorrow. #PresidentsCup

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text: Medinah. 2012 Ryder Cup. Europe came back from 10-6 down on the final day. Now Geoff Ogilvy's International team arrives at the same venue hoping for their own miracle. The Presidents Cup starts tomorrow. #PresidentsCup #Golf

article.headline: Presidents Cup Eve: The International Team's 28-Year Wait Comes Down to Tomorrow at Medinah

stories.title: PGA Tour Slams the Door — LIV Players Have No Easy Path Back, 20 Days Left

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text: PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp: "We are not currently contemplating a returning member programme." The January window is closed. The Oct. 13 LIV restructuring deadline is 20 days away. There is no easy way back. #LIVGolf #PGATour

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text: Brooks Koepka paid $5M to charity and forfeited 5 years of PGA Tour equity to come back in January. Rahm. DeChambeau. Smith. They said no. The door is now closed. The LIV deadline is 20 days out. #LIVGolf #Golf

stories.title: International Team's Last Stand — 28 Years Without a Win, Starting Tomorrow

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: The International team has lost 12 consecutive Presidents Cups. Their last win: 1998, Royal Melbourne. Tomorrow at Medinah, Matsuyama, Tom Kim, Min Woo Lee, Adam Scott, and the rest get their next chance. #PresidentsCup

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text: Geoff Ogilvy won the 2006 US Open at Winged Foot. Now he's captaining the International team at Medinah. 28 years without a Presidents Cup title. Tomorrow the drought either ends or continues. #PresidentsCup #Golf

stories.title: Rahm, DeChambeau, Smith Rejected the PGA Tour's Offer — Now What?

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text: January 2026: PGA Tour offered a return window for Major and Players winners. Jon Rahm (2023 Masters, US Open). Bryson DeChambeau (2024 US Open). Cameron Smith (2022 Players). All three said no. The door is now shut. #Golf #LIVGolf

stories.title: Walmart NW Arkansas Championship Preview — Korda and the Solheim Returnees

x_posts.label: Post 8
x_posts.text: LPGA Tour is back Thursday. @NellyKorda returns to competition at the Walmart NW Arkansas Championship — first event after the Solheim Cup. World No. 1. Won the Chevron. Won the US Women's Open. Unbeaten at Solheim. #LPGA #Golf

x_posts.label: Post 9
x_posts.text: USA lost the Solheim Cup 13-15 to Europe last weekend. Nelly Korda went unbeaten individually — including a 4&2 singles win. Now she leads 17 US Solheim players into NW Arkansas starting Thursday. #LPGA #SolheimCup
